# The thing `journey`

Rendered from `src/things/journey/` by `pnpm claims`: each verb's file holds its declaration and its
promises. Do not edit it by hand: a test fails when this page and its sources differ. What the runner checks on
every call, and the starting worlds a promise is in, are in [index.md](index.md).

## Work no door serves

The pipeline's own work (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 8): no Rpc group holds it, so nothing serves it at run
time. Its spans and logs judge it once it is instrumented (roadmap item 4.7). Its budget is a target, never a gate.

### `journey.run`

Reset a shard's world to the journey's starting point, take the journey's steps, and check every call.

- Payload: `journey`, `world`, `from`.
- Spans: `journey.run.wait` (wait).
- Logs: `journey.run.step_failed` (journey, step).
- Budget: 60,000 ms, a target, provisional. Basis: a shard's 6 minutes hold several journeys (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 8); a first guess per journey.
